title: Funding/basis carry and convergence in fully funded spot-perpetual cash-and-carry

registration_state.reason_new_protocol_is_required: No D2-D4 economic protocol existed before this outcome-blind registration.

economic_mechanism: Persistent positive perpetual-futures funding and positive spot-perpetual basis reflect levered long demand. A fully funded long-spot/short-perpetual position supplies balance sheet, receives funding and is directionally hedged; the effect is economically real only if realized carry and basis convergence exceed conservative execution costs and survive asset and time replication.
hypothesis: A strictly ex-ante positive funding observation together with positive spot-perpetual basis identifies persistent carry episodes whose fully funded long-spot/short-perpetual net return is positive, economically material and replicable.
null_hypothesis: After conservative costs, the ex-ante positive-funding/positive-basis rule has non-positive or non-replicable delta-neutral return; any apparent effect is explained by market direction, calendar structure or a control signal.

economic_unit.capitalization: fully funded; two units of committed capital per unit of matched notional

event_and_execution_rule.signal_time: At each official funding calc_time t, after last_funding_rate becomes observable.
event_and_execution_rule.basis_information: The last fully completed common 5-minute candle ending immediately before t.
event_and_execution_rule.entry: If flat and eligible, enter both legs at the open of the first common candle strictly after t (t+5m).
event_and_execution_rule.holding: Remain open while every newly observed funding event is eligible.
event_and_execution_rule.funding_cashflow: While open at funding event t, short-leg cashflow per initial matched notional equals last_funding_rate(t) * mark_close(t-5m) / perp_entry_price.
event_and_execution_rule.exit: After the first ineligible funding event, exit both legs at the first common candle open strictly after t; the funding cashflow at t is included because the position was open at settlement.
event_and_execution_rule.excluded_block_position_rule: For every globally excluded UTC day, force-close any open episode at the last common candle close before the block; ignore all events inside the block; permit a new episode only from the first eligible funding event after the block.
event_and_execution_rule.boundary: Force-close any open episode at the final common candle close of the stage or temporal block and include it with a boundary flag.
event_and_execution_rule.lookahead_prohibition: No candle closing after a decision time may determine that decision.

return_definition.cost_components: One immutable conservative envelope for entry and exit of both legs, including trading fees and slippage; no account-tier, maker-rebate or historical favorable imputation.

statistics.primary_estimator: Mean episode net return per matched notional.
statistics.uncertainty: Cluster bootstrap over UTC entry weeks; every resampled week retains all assets and episodes entering that week.
statistics.multiple_testing: Holm correction at family-wise alpha 0.05, separately for asset, temporal and negative-control families.
statistics.market_neutrality: OLS beta of episode net return on contemporaneous spot-leg return, with cluster-bootstrap 95% CI.

negative_controls.rule: Within each asset, use the funding/basis eligibility state circularly shifted forward by exactly 30 UTC days; outcomes and execution timestamps remain unchanged.
Use the contemporaneous eligibility state of the next asset in the frozen alphabetical universe, cyclically; outcomes remain those of the target asset.

gates: At least 8 assets meet the episode minimum.
Aggregate mean net episode return > 0, bootstrap lower 95% bound > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05.
Annualized committed-capital return is at least 10%.
At least 8 assets have positive point estimates and at least 5 have Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
All three temporal blocks have positive point estimates and at least two have Holm-adjusted p < 0.05.
Neither negative control has a positive Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 result.
Market-neutrality beta absolute point estimate <= 0.10 and its 95% interval contains zero.

d3.sample: sealed historical holdout, opened once only after protocol hash is frozen
d3.gates: Identical to D2 except for the pre-registered holdout episode minimum of 10 per asset.

d4.conditional_dataset_sensitivity: Mandatory regardless of D2/D3 direction: delete every eligible fully observed UTC day globally, one at a time, and rerun the exact D2 and D3 decision pipelines.
d4.dependence_rule: If any matched-day deletion changes either stage decision or the resulting final conclusion, H01 is INCONCLUSIVE.
d4.economic_robustness: The 0.6% cost envelope is primary and may not be changed. No alternative cost, signal, horizon, lag or universe is tested.
d4.promotion_constraint: A historical pass can justify prospective confirmation only; it cannot authorize a bot without prospective replication and execution-level viability evidence.

final_decision.CONFIRMED_READY_FOR_PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMA: D2 PASS, D3 PASS, D4 stable, every replication and economic gate passes; no bot is authorized.
final_decision.REJECTED: At least one D2/D3 gate fails and the D4 matched-block analysis shows that the rejection is stable.
final_decision.INCONCLUSIVE: The matched-block conclusion changes, a required calculation cannot be identified from the frozen data, or a protocol integrity gate fails.
